Flow Traders is seeking a highly capable, experienced and proactive Executive Assistant to support the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) at our Amsterdam HQ. In this pivotal role, you will provide high-level administrative and strategic support directly to the CEO, ensuring the seamless management of the CEO’s day-to-day activities and enabling the CEO to focus on key business priorities and strategic decision-making at a global level. 

You will be a trusted partner to the CEO, taking full ownership of a complex and fast-moving schedule, coordinating a high volume of internal and external engagements, and anticipating needs before they arise. This role requires sound judgement, confidence, discretion and the ability to stay several steps ahead in a dynamic international environment. 


What you will do

  • Manage the CEO’s complex calendar, communications and international travel across multiple time zones
  • Act as a trusted gatekeeper, prioritising competing demands and ensuring the CEO’s time is used effectively
  • Coordinate senior-level meetings, business trips and roadshows, including agendas, itineraries, logistics and briefing materials
  • Anticipate scheduling conflicts and changing priorities, proactively resolving issues and adjusting plans where needed
  • Ensure the CEO is prepared for meetings by coordinating agendas, pre-reads, presentations and other relevant materials
  • Act as a key liaison between the CEO, Management Board, internal teams and external stakeholders
  • Handle confidential and sensitive information with a high level of discretion and professionalism
  • Support board meetings, offsites and strategic or cross-functional projects
  • Manage expenses, invoices and approvals accurately and efficiently
  • Work closely with other Executive Assistants to provide seamless support and coverage
  • Provide flexibility and responsiveness outside standard working hours when required

What you need to succeed

  • A minimum of 5 years working experience as an Executive Assistant
  • Extensive experience supporting a CEO, C-suite or Management Board executive, ideally in financial services, trading or another fast-paced international environment
  • Exceptional calendar management, organisation and prioritisation skills, with experience managing complex schedules and international travel
  • Highly proactive and solutions-oriented, with excellent judgement and the confidence to take initiative independently
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the confidence to work with senior internal and external stakeholders
  • High level of discretion, integrity and professionalism when handling confidential information
  • Calm, adaptable and highly organised, with the ability to manage shifting priorities and work effectively under pressure
  • Strong attention to detail, ownership and follow-through, with a collaborative and hands-on approach
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and collaboration and AI platforms (Claude, Copilot, SharePoint)
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; additional languages are a plus
  • Comfortable working 5 days a week in the office and and working flexible hours 

What we offer

At Flow Traders, we create the conditions for hard‑working, high‑performing people to do their best work. From a thorough onboarding and ongoing access to Flow Academy, to latest technology and a collaborative, non‑hierarchical culture, we give you the tools, ownership, and support to move fast and drive outcomes. We keep a close‑knit, small‑company feel while offering competitive salary, annual discretionary profit share, and comprehensive benefits, so talent can grow here, and stay here. See our benefits below:

  • Flow Academy and opportunities to attend domain-related conferences
  • Daily catered lunch, great coffee, and a fully stocked kitchen and snack bar
  • In-house Bar and Lounge with arcade, table tennis, billiards, and game consoles
  • Company boat
  • In-house gym and sessions with personal trainer
  • Bi-weekly massages
  • Annual company trip and a variety of events throughout the year, such as the New Years Event
  • Global rotations across our offices worldwide
  • and more

Flow Traders does not accept unsolicited resumes from any professional staffing or search firms. All resumes, and any other information identifying potential candidates, submitted to any employee at Flow Traders via-email, the Internet or directly without a valid and signed search agreement will be deemed free to contact by Flow Traders without any restrictions and no placement fee of any kind will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by Flow Traders.

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The IAM Control Plane team’s mission is to empower Stripe users to easily and securely manage their access to Stripe products and data. As part of Stripe's Organizations and Auth Platform, we own the platform for API keys, user roles, and access auditing, ensuring the right people have the keys to the kingdom - and no one else. We are a team of around 10 engineers with an ambitious roadmap, blending deep platform work with direct product impact.

You will design, build, and maintain the critical systems that control our user’s access to Stripe.

  • Design and build the next generation of IAM primitives to securely power AI-driven agentic experiences on Stripe
  • Develop new user-facing permission models, including custom roles and granular access controls
  • Architect and implement platform features like Account Groups to simplify access management for large organizations
  • Own and operate mission-critical, highly-available backend services that are fundamental to every Stripe user's experience
  • Work across the stack to ship end-to-end features, from API design and database modeling to frontend components

About the Role

We are seeking a motivated Junior Property Manager to support the daily operations of a midsize property in our portfolio, located in Boston, MA. The ideal candidate is organized, detail-oriented, and eager to grow their property management career. This role works closely with the property management and maintenance teams to ensure smooth day-to-day operations while taking on increasing responsibility across key functional areas. This position will work out of our HQ located in downtown Boston. 

Facility Management

  • Support the day-to-day operations of our properties
  • Ensure that properties are maintained to a high standard and in compliance with all relevant regulations and codes
  • Conduct regular property inspections to identify maintenance issues and coordinate timely resolution
  • Assist with emergency service coordination and generate incident reports as needed
  • Develop a working knowledge of maintenance programs and capital improvement projects to support efficient operations and resident service requests

Collaboration

  • Work alongside Property Operations team members, including maintenance technicians and associates, to carry out daily responsibilities
  • Analyze rents to aid in substantiating property underwriting
  • Support team in monitoring regulatory compliance and reinforcing company policies and procedures
  • Assist in developing and maintaining relationships with local vendors and contractors
  • Participate in bidding out property services to vendors and support the review of vendor contracts

Resident Services

  • Handle resident inquiries and concerns in a professional and timely manner
  • Coordinate onsite resident events to foster community and manage use of onsite amenities (gym, rec room, pool, roof deck, etc.)
  • Support leasing efforts for available units and assist with property marketing
  • Coordinate resident on-boarding and off-boarding processes, and assist with eviction procedures in partnership with legal counsel

Property Reporting

  • Track and report leasing operations metrics including responding to inquiries, coordinating tours, processing applications, lead-to-lease conversion and assisting with lease execution and renewals
  • Assist in managing property-level budgets and tracking expenses to ensure alignment with allocated budgets
  • Prepare and maintain operating reports on a weekly, monthly, and annual cadence
  • Track delinquency and unpaid balances and support collections efforts on past and current residents

Experience 

  • 2–3 years of experience in property management or a related real estate operations field
  • Strong organizational, documentation, and task management skills
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Knowledge of relevant laws and regulations related to property management, including fair housing laws
  • Familiarity with Greater Boston Area real estate market
  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively as part of a team
  • Availability to work evenings and weekends as needed

About our Culture

At Groma, we’re looking to build something big and are on a very fast growth trajectory. While a healthy work-life balance is important to our team, we want to be upfront that there may be times when we expect commitments outside of the standard 9-5. We strive to respect individuals and their needs, while also acknowledging the reality that we have a small team that is trying to accomplish some very ambitious goals in a short period of time.

We have an ever-evolving list of values and conventions that guide how we operate as a company, but here’s a high-level overview of how we think about doing what we do:

  • We’re committed to building an inclusive, equal opportunity, anti-discriminatory workplace that reflects the diversity of people and cultures that live, work, and play in the communities we seek to serve.
  • We approach our work with pragmatic idealism that enables us to focus on our desire to make the world a better place in ways big and small while also being open to intelligent compromises that accelerate us on our path to serve our broader societal goals.
  • Our whole team believes strongly in a value we shorthand as Justice League, not Superman. The challenges we are trying to solve require effective teams, not individual heroes. (Note: Yes… we are aware that Superman has been a member of the Justice League for quite some time now, but the analogy here is an easy, yet powerful, one for people to grasp. We don’t need a hero, we need a collaborative team of heroes who each bring something unique to the table to help solve problems that any of us individually would find daunting.)

Job Benefits

We offer a competitive salary and benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) with company match, and paid time off. If you are interested in this exciting opportunity, please submit your resume and cover letter for consideration.

  • 5% 401k match
  • Fully covered insurance premiums for dental, health, and vision plans
  • Fully covered commuter passes for bus, subway, boat, or commuter rail
  • Generous paid time off policy including vacation, holiday, sick time, and parental leave
  • 13 official company holidays
  • 1 floating holiday: We recognize that there are lots of holidays that are meaningful to different people in different ways and we want to celebrate that by enabling team members to have the time/space to commemorate those days however is appropriate, and using it as an opportunity - if they’d like to - to share the meaning of that day with the broader team

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and open up new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a lot of work ahead. That gives you an unusual opportunity to help put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Startup SaaS Platforms team works with European startups in one of Stripe’s must-win segments. SaaS platforms are companies that use Stripe to embed payments and make financial services a core part of their products, such as Shopify, Mindbody, and Lightspeed. For these companies, their partnership with Stripe is vital to the success of their businesses.

SaaS platforms are a global priority for Stripe, and our team finds and wins Stripe’s future strategic accounts in Europe. We partner with high-potential companies early and help them use Stripe’s solutions to better support their users, scale globally, and create new revenue streams by monetising payments and financial services.

What you’ll do

We’re hiring an Account Executive to win new business with pre-revenue and early-stage SaaS platform startups across the United Kingdom and Ireland. This is a new-logo role. Your job is to find the most promising founders building platforms today, win their business for Stripe before they choose another provider, and get them live with the right integration from day one.

You’ll work alongside our SaaS Platform Account Executives as the team’s dedicated hunter for the earliest stage of the market. You’ll own the pre-revenue and early-revenue segment end to end, from generating pipeline and handling inbound demand to closing deals and getting each new platform activated.

Early-stage platforms make their payments decisions early and rarely revisit them. They also often need several products from the start, including embedded payments, connected-account onboarding, payouts, and monetisation. Winning them early and selling the right solution gives Stripe a lasting position with the platforms that will scale fastest. This is a high-velocity sales role with short cycles, a high volume of opportunities, and plenty of competitive deals.

Responsibilities

  • Build and run your own pipeline. Prospect high-potential pre-revenue and early-stage SaaS platforms across the United Kingdom and Ireland, and turn inbound interest from early-stage platforms into qualified opportunities.
  • Win new logos. Run fast, consultative sales cycles from discovery to close and win competitive evaluations against other payments providers.
  • Sell the right solution from the start. Understand each founder’s business model and position the right Stripe Connect integration and payments monetisation strategy so that new platforms are set up to scale.
  • Close and activate. Negotiate and close deals, then work with Solutions Architects, Product, Risk, and Operations to get new platforms live quickly. You’ll be measured on new business won and activated.
  • Source new business through the ecosystem. Build relationships with founders, venture capital firms, accelerators, and startup communities across the United Kingdom and Ireland to create pipeline and grow Stripe’s presence among early-stage founders.
  • Work with the SaaS Platform Account Executive team. Share market intelligence on emerging platforms and pass on accounts that have moved beyond the early stage so that each seller can focus on the opportunities where they can have the greatest impact.
  • Bring what you learn from the market back to Product and go-to-market teams to sharpen how Stripe wins early-stage platforms.

Who you are

You’re a self-starting hunter who enjoys finding and winning new business. You like working with founders, you’re comfortable leading technical conversations, and you can run many deals at once without compromising quality. You know how to qualify quickly, create urgency, and close. You’re competitive, resilient, and keen to build your skills in a fast-changing environment.

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 2+ years of experience in a new-business sales role, such as a closing Account Executive role or a Sales or Business Development Representative role, with a track record of progression and pipeline generation
  • A proven record of meeting or exceeding new-business targets
  • Strong prospecting skills, with experience building your own pipeline through outbound and inbound channels
  • Experience running high-velocity sales cycles from the first conversation through to close
  • The ability to understand technical products and explain their value clearly to technical and non-technical buyers
  • Comfort with rejection, competitive deals, and ambiguous, fast-moving environments
  • A bias towards team success, collaboration, and knowledge sharing
  • Proficiency in written and spoken English

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience selling to early-stage or venture-backed startups, ideally in the United Kingdom and Ireland
  • An established network in the United Kingdom and Ireland startup ecosystem, including founders, venture capital firms, and accelerators
  • Experience selling at a high-growth technology company
  • Comfort with API-first products and technical sales conversations
  • Experience in payments, fintech, or SaaS platform sales

Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

About the role

The Senior Intelligence Analyst owns TRM’s blockchain intelligence for a priority coverage area. You turn on-chain tracing, OSINT, and diverse intel signals into finished intelligence across scam/fraud, counter-narcotics, and facilitation and money laundering. You lead industry-leading work against professional money laundering organizations, illicit gambling networks, and related actors.

What is unique here: you build the AI-driven pipelines that turn many signals into attribution, making one of TRM’s highest-priority coverage areas a strength.

The impact you will have

  • Deepen TRM’s coverage by owning your area end-to-end and delivering finished, source-cited intelligence products across multiple threat categories.

  • Build end-to-end AI capability that processes a wide variety of intel signals and augments target selection, so you generate leads faster and at greater scale.

  • Trace funds across chains and through obfuscation, and correlate on-chain activity with OSINT, including Mandarin-language sources, to attribute money laundering organizations, threat actors, and gambling networks.

  • Drive attribution and leads that improve delivery in Mission (scam/fraud), Counter Narcotics, Nation States, and Facilitation and Money Laundering.

  • Set ambitious, industry-leading targets for your coverage area and raise the bar on tradecraft.

  • Build reusable AI pipelines and methods the broader Intelligence team adopts.

What we’re looking for

  • 5 to 8+ years in blockchain intelligence, crypto investigations, threat intelligence, or financial-crime investigations.

  • Strong OSINT and off-chain investigative tradecraft: you connect on-chain activity to real-world people, companies, and networks. Hands-on blockchain tracing experience is a plus, not a requirement; we train strong investigators on our tooling.

  • Domain expertise in professional money laundering organizations, illicit gambling networks, and underground banking.

  • Mandarin Chinese fluency is a strong plus.

  • Production AI fluency: you build end-to-end pipelines that process diverse intel signals and augment target selection, and you critically evaluate the output.

  • A track record of independently running complex investigations and producing clear, source-cited written intelligence.

  • US-based preferred, not required.

About the Team

  • You will join TRM’s Blockchain Intelligence (Primary Intelligence) organization, a distributed team producing finished intelligence across threat categories.

  • The work is intellectually demanding: you keep real investigative proficiency across on-chain and OSINT tradecraft while owning a priority coverage area.

  • Mission-first, high-autonomy, execution-oriented culture with rigorous analytical standards.

  • AI-native team: analysts build reusable pipelines the whole team adopts.

Team Operating Rhythms

  • Distributed, not distant: a US-based analyst collaborating across time zones with regular overlap for syncs.

  • Slack-first, async communication; @mention for timely responses.

  • Weekly 1:1s and team syncs, plus case and category rhythms.

  • Regular cross-category coordination with other Intelligence pods and Global Investigations.

  • Required online and collaboration hours: standard business hours in your timezone, with 3-4 hours overlap across US time zones (EST preferred) for internal syncs.

Travel Requirements:

  • Schedule: Occasional travel for team engagements.

  • Frequency: Low.

Onsite Requirements:

  • Schedule: None required; distributed/remote role.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position

  • Within your first 30 days, take ownership of an active case in your coverage area and deliver a finished, source-cited intelligence product.

  • Within 60 days, build an end-to-end AI pipeline that processes diverse intel signals for augmented target selection and that another analyst can reuse.

  • Within 90 days, measurably deepen coverage against money laundering organizations or gambling networks, with attribution and leads that support cross-category delivery.

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

  • First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

  • Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

  • References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

  • Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

  • Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly

  • Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.

Privacy Policy and Additional Information

What you’ll do

Responsibilities

  • Provide strategic and operational leadership for the newly-formed People Support team in CDMX, translating the global Core Ops strategy into an effective local operating model.

  • Establish local team practices, coverage, escalation paths, and ways of working that integrate effectively with the global People Support organization.
  • Manage daily operations, including queue health, workload allocation, service levels, and escalations, while contributing directly during the team’s ramp or periods of high volume.

  • Maintain high standards for case handling, written responses, documentation, data accuracy, privacy, and operational controls.
  • Identify opportunities to expand the CDMX team’s capabilities and use AI tools thoughtfully to improve service quality, operational efficiency, and the team’s ability to scale.

Skills

  • Strategic and operational leadership, including the ability to establish new team practices while contributing directly to service delivery.
